params.name: Tessa
params.purpose: Develop her own martial training through the local practice ground, explore Meridian foundations and decide her goals independently.
params.personality: Determined, independently minded, observant and willing to defend her reasoning; friendly with Maddoc and Bram but not a follower.
params.background: A young local friend whom Maddoc encountered with Bram. She has begun martial training at the practice ground and studied introductory Meridian material; no mechanical proficiency or rank is presumed.
params.witness: Maddoc and Tessa previously travelled together to Mossgate Common and studied while their personal interests began taking shape.
params.journalWitness: Maddoc said 'Just follow me' and led willing companions Tessa and Bram to Mossgate Common.

scene: Rootday 08:30 at Thistlebell Yard. Maddoc is speaking with the handler after searching for his parents. Tessa is a previously met local friend, who began martial training and kept Meridian notes; her current whereabouts and recent progress are unknown. Bram is an earlier friend who studied Arcane. Neither friend is asserted present at this yard.
summary: Register Tessa's established past acquaintance identity only. Her previously witnessed Mossgate visit and player-confirmed start of martial training inform her interests, but no rank, session result, presence, wage or hidden knowledge is awarded. Maddoc remains with the Thistlebell handler at 08:30.
focus: Search for parents at Thistlebell Yard
Tessa and Bram live independent lives without being summoned
